name: Command Code
note: Quota only. The rolling and weekly caps come from `windowLimits`, which Command Code returns either at the top level or inside a `data` envelope depending on the call — both paths are declared rather than guessed. The monthly credit balance is deliberately not charted: turning it into a percentage needs a plan-id-to-allowance table that only the vendor knows, and an unrecognised plan would produce a confident wrong number. The response shape is published nowhere; checked 2026-09-22, commandcode.ai/docs/resources/usage-limits documents the windows themselves — a five-hour cap and a weekly one on every plan, which is what the two keys here are named for — and points at the CLI's own /usage for reading them. The fixture is the whole of the check.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live plan.
